How trade-in works
1. Upgrade and save
Accept your estimated trade-in value, buy your new device at the current price, and receive your delivery.
2. Prepare device
Sign out of all accounts linked to your old device, and factory reset it to erase your personal information.
3. Ship within 30 days
Print your shipping label, package your old device, and drop it off at any UPS location within 30 days of receiving your new device.
4. Get your rebate
After we receive your trade-in device, we'll verify it within 10 business days. Once verified, you'll receive your trade-in value as an Amazon.com Gift Card to your Amazon account for immediate use.

What is Amazon Renewed?
Amazon Renewed is your trusted destination for pre-owned, refurbished products. Products sold on Amazon Renewed are professionally inspected and tested to work as expected by an Amazon qualified and performance-managed supplier. If we source products from a third-party seller, the third-party seller tests and inspects the product.
What should I expect to receive with my Amazon Renewed purchase?
Amazon Renewed purchases will come with accessories equivalent to those that shipped in the box when new. These items may not be original but will be compatible and fully functional. Amazon Renewed products will be packaged in either original packaging or in a new and clean cardboard box. Learn more
What is the Amazon Renewed Guarantee?
If you are unsatisfied with your purchase, return the product within 90 days of receipt of your original purchase (or within 365 days of receipt of a Renewed Premium or Renewed Automotive product) for a full refund or a replacement. Learn more
What are the refurbished condition types?
Amazon Renewed pre-owned products have been inspected, tested, and refurbished as necessary to be fully functional and in one of four conditions:

Refurbished - Premium

  • Screen: When present, no scratches.
  • Body: No signs of cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, and other) are visible when the product is held 12 inches away.
  • Battery: When included, batteries have a capacity that exceeds 90% of the original battery life.
  • Accessories: Generic or original equipment manufacturer accessories and packaging provided.
  • Guarantee: Renewed Premium items come with a 365-day return period.

Refurbished - Excellent

  • Screen: When present, no scratches.
  • Body: No signs of cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, and other) are visible when the product is held 12 inches away.
  • Battery: When included, batteries have a capacity that exceeds 80% of the original battery life.
  • Accessories: Generic or original equipment manufacturer accessories and packaging provided.
  • Guarantee: 90-day Amazon Renewed Guarantee (or within 365 days of receipt of a Renewed Automotive product).

Refurbished - Good

  • Screen: When present, no scratches.
  • Body: Light scratches, barely visible when holding the product 12 inches away, and imperceptible to touch.
  • Battery: When included, batteries have a capacity that exceeds 80% of the original battery life.
  • Accessories: Generic or original equipment manufacturer accessories and packaging provided.
  • Guarantee: 90-day Amazon Renewed Guarantee (or within 365 days of receipt of a Renewed Automotive product).

Refurbished - Acceptable

  • Screen: When present, may have a small number of shallow scratches that are invisible when the screen is turned on.
  • Body: Light scratches, clearly visible when holding the product 12 inches away, and perceptible to touch.
  • Battery: When included, batteries have a capacity that exceeds 80% of the original battery life.
  • Accessories: Generic or original equipment manufacturer accessories and packaging provided.
  • Guarantee: 90-day Amazon Renewed Guarantee (or within 365 days of receipt of a Renewed Automotive product).

What is Amazon Renewed?
Amazon Renewed is your trusted destination for products that are inspected, tested, and refurbished as necessary to be fully functional.
Quality you can afford
Amazon Renewed products offer an affordable option so you can save on the brands you love.
Products you can trust
All products have been professionally inspected, tested, cleaned, and refurbished as necessary by Amazon-qualified suppliers. Products are not certified by Apple.
Trusted coverage
Your purchase is eligible for Amazon Renewed coverage in conjunction with Amazon's Return Policy and the A-to-z Guarantee.
Purchases with an impact
Your Amazon Renewed purchase extends the lifetime of this product and reduces electronic waste.
What should I expect to receive with my Amazon Renewed purchase?
All Amazon Renewed purchases will come with accessories equivalent to those that shipped in the box when new. These items may not be original but will be compatible and fully functional. Amazon Renewed products will be packaged in either original packaging or in a new and clean cardboard box.
In what condition can I expect my Amazon Renewed product to be?
Product will be restored to its original factory settings and will be in one of the following cosmetic conditions Premium, Excellent, Good or Acceptable. Learn more
